stage1.impression: A warm, coherent dusk interior with a nicely textured walnut cabinet, but the record player is a small, dim, murky-red object low in the frame while the lamp, top right, is the brightest and clearest thing in the picture. The cropped red speaker at the left edge glows like neon slabs and pulls the eye. The fluted cabinet front fills the bottom third. It reads as a competent CG interior, not a campaign photograph, and the hero is not the hero.

blocking_9: The record player must be the brightest and most saturated object in frame: plinth/platter median luminance at least as high as the lamp shade, and the light passing through its acrylic visible as glowing edges
The record player must fill at least 45% of the frame width at near eye level, with the camera not looking down at about 20 degrees
The lamp must read as the light source for the record player: a visible warm pool on the cabinet top reaching the plinth, not a cone thrown onto the wall
No clipped, flat white block inside the lamp shade (currently 9.6% clipped in the bulb region)
The left-edge speaker must either read as a speaker (horn silhouette, not glowing LED slabs) or leave the frame
Dusk must be legible: some cool window light against the warm lamp, instead of an all-red monochrome
The fluted cabinet front must recede (darker, out of focus or cropped) instead of taking the lower third

defects.what: Hero underexposed: median luminance 19.5 against a wall median of 128 behind it; acrylic reads as dark red-brown glass, not lit tinted acrylic
Lamp bulb/diffuser renders as a flat white rectangle, 9.6% clipped, a 'render' tell and the brightest point in the frame
Lamp shade is the most luminous object (mean 104) and competes with the hero
Lamp's light throws a hard shade-shadow cone onto the wall instead of lighting the record player
Speaker cropped at the frame edge; its LED panels read as glowing red neon slabs (r 141, g 17), no horn silhouette
Fluted cabinet front takes the bottom 27% of the frame with high-contrast stripes (p95 96, p5 9), the busiest texture in the image
Wall plaster has a soft, smudged, slightly upscaled look; large empty bright field with a left-to-right ramp 93 to 135
Weak contact shadow and no red light cast onto the walnut under the plinth; the record player sits on, rather than tints, the cabinet
Lamp base sharpening halos and a slightly plastic look on the acrylic edges

changes.problem: The hero is about 2.7 stops darker than the wall behind it, so it reads as a dark lump.

change.to: area 0.6x0.4 m, az -20, el 25, 1.1 m, 70 W, 2900 K, target [0.36, 0.42, 0.74], with a flag (blocker) so it does not spill above z 0.95 onto the wall

changes.expected: Plinth edges and platter rim glow red where light travels through the acrylic; top of the record player median luminance rises to 75-100 while the wall stays unchanged.

changes.problem: The camera sits high and wide, looking down on a small hero in the lower-left third with a third of the frame given to the cabinet front.

evidence.measured: record player spans about 450 of 1600 px (28%); cabinet front occupies y 800-1100

changes.expected: Near eye level, about 10 degrees down; the record player fills about 50% of the frame width, the lamp sits behind-right partly out of focus, the cabinet front is cropped to a thin band or out of frame.

changes.problem: The lamp lights the wall rather than the record player and outshines it.

changes.problem: The lamp's internal emitter clips into a flat white rectangle.

changes.problem: The speaker's LED panels at the left edge are the most saturated surface and read as neon slabs, not context.
